coordinates: CAD world coordinates: +Z up; front is -Y. Explode offsets are illustrative, not an assembly-motion simulation.

parts.label: Base enclosure
parts.description: Fixed electronics housing with an integrated vertical front for five LEDs and optional OLED. Closed USB wall and BOOT access bore; drill the DC-jack hole after checking actual components.

parts.label: Main lid
parts.description: Removable fixed lid with two rear hooks and two front M3x12 fastener sets. Remove the screws, slide the lid forward to disengage its hooks, then lift for service. This part does not carry spool weight.

parts.label: Weighing carrier
parts.description: Floating carrier attached to the load cell. Keep it clear of the fixed enclosure.

parts.label: Rear cradle rail
parts.description: One of two identical keyed rails supporting the upright spool rims. Two locating keys resist rotation; one central M3x12 fastener secures each rail. Remove the side guides before lifting the rail for service.

parts.label: Front cradle rail
parts.description: Second instance of the same keyed rail, secured by one central M3x12 fastener. Its placement is separate and selectable. Remove the side guides before lifting the rail for service.

parts.label: Adjustable side guide
parts.description: Adjusts to the spool width. Target range: 50–100 mm.

parts.label: NFC side guide
parts.description: Width-adjustable guide with an integrated rear cable cassette. Two nylon M3x12 clamps set the reader height. Verify cable slack and non-contact routing before use.

parts.label: NFC reader pod
parts.description: Reader housing with four PCB edge seats; the board is captured by the rear cover fingers without PCB screws. Rotate the seated spool to align its tag. Delivered board margins and foam pressure require checking.

parts.label: NFC pod cover
parts.description: PN532 rear cover with PCB edge-capture fingers, a rigid upper tongue and one nylon M3x12 clamp. Service on the bench: first remove both height-clamp screws and washers, leave the unthreaded nuts in the mast, and unplug or free the cable. Lift the complete pod from its nominal 155 mm centre height to a 215 mm centre height above the guide, then withdraw it 20 mm outward. On the bench, release the cover clamp, slide the cover 4 mm down, then 20 mm outward.

parts.label: 5 kg load cell
parts.description: Nominal 80 × 12.7 × 12.7 mm bar cell. Two M4x25 and two M5x12 mounting screws are included in the purchase list but omitted from the model. Verify the delivered cell, threads and calibration.

parts.label: ESP32-S3 controller
parts.description: N16R8 development board reference. PCB, connectors and BOOT button are approximate; verify your board.

parts.label: HX711 amplifier
parts.description: Nominal HX711 PCB envelope. Receives the load-cell signal; actual wiring is not modeled.

parts.label: PN532 NFC reader
parts.description: PN532 module captured at its edges inside the side pod. No PCB screws are required; delivered board margins, components, foam allowance and wire fit require a physical check.

parts.label: Five addressable LEDs
parts.description: 5 V strip at 60 LEDs/metre, 16.67 mm centres. Strip width and package dimensions remain provisional.

parts.label: 0.96-inch OLED
parts.description: Generic 128 × 64 OLED envelope. Controller, PCB size and pin order require identification.

parts.label: Four adjustable stop sets
parts.description: Four M3x12 metal stop screws with M3 nylon-insert locknuts. Set a clearance below the floating carrier, then lock the adjustment; actual overload behavior remains untested.

parts.label: Reference spool
parts.description: 200 mm diameter × 80 mm wide reference spool. Design target: up to 100 mm wide; physical fit unverified.

parts.label: Internal USB plug space
parts.description: Provisional 10 × 22 × 12 mm angled-plug envelope. No external USB opening.

parts.label: BOOT tool approach
parts.description: Approximate access path to the onboard BOOT button; verify reach with the actual board.

parts.label: PN532 wire space
parts.description: Reserved connector clearance. No real wire routing or cable stiffness is represented.

parts.label: Load-cell wire space
parts.description: Reserved wire-exit clearance at the load cell, not a cable model.

parts.label: OLED pin space
parts.description: Provisional OLED header and connector allowance; check the supplied module.

parts.label: Two lid fastener sets
parts.description: Two nominal metal M3x12 screws with washers and captive nuts secure the front of the main lid; rigid rear hooks retain the other end. Illustrated hardware envelopes; actual fit remains untested.

parts.label: Two rail fastener sets
parts.description: Two nominal metal M3x12 screws with washers and captive nuts, one centred on each keyed cradle rail. The exploded layout is illustrative, not an installation sequence.

parts.label: Four guide clamp sets
parts.description: Four nominal metal M3x12 clamp screws with washers and captive nuts for spool-width adjustment. Inspect the assembled view for their exact modeled locations.

parts.label: NFC cable channel cover
parts.description: Removable cable-cassette cover retained by one rigid upper tongue and one nylon M3x12 clamp. Remove the screw, slide the cover 3.5 mm in +Y, then 20 mm outward in +X for service; verify actual cable clearance throughout adjustment.

parts.label: NFC cable · nominal height
parts.description: Nominal-height routing reference behind the NFC guide, from the reader toward the lower chute. This is a dimensional path, not a qualified cable assembly.

parts.label: NFC cable · lowest height
parts.description: Routing reference at the lowest planned reader height. Shown separately from the nominal assembly; it represents the same cable at another position.

parts.label: NFC cable · highest height
parts.description: Routing reference at the highest planned reader height. Shown separately from the nominal assembly; it represents the same cable at another position.

parts.label: Cable flex space inside base
parts.description: Nominal free-flex routing reference inside the fixed base after the non-contact passage. Check the actual wires through full width and height travel; cable drag and zero shift remain untested.

parts.label: Four nylon NFC fastener sets
parts.description: Four nylon M3x12 screws, washers and nuts: two reader-height clamps, one pod-cover clamp and one cable-cover clamp. Nylon hardware limits metal near the antenna; NFC performance and clamp strength require physical checks.
